title: A world beneath
summary: Follow the currents into an extraordinary underwater world.
description: Explore how light, pressure and movement shape life below the surface. This fictional exhibition brings ocean habitats into focus through stories of adaptation and discovery.

title: Shaping light
summary: Discover the colour, shadows and ideas hiding in everyday light.
description: See familiar materials transformed by colour and shadow. This fictional exhibition explores how artists use light to change our understanding of everyday spaces.

title: The restless earth
summary: Look closer at the forces that shape the ground beneath our feet.
description: Trace the slow movement of landscapes and the sudden changes that reveal a planet in motion. This fictional exhibition introduces geological time through approachable visual stories.
